Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:10:1.english: Distinguishing marks of the string - With which the bill of divorce is tied.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:12:1.english: His neighbors - [This is] explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:12:2.english: So that he will go - Each one to his home.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:12:3.hebrew: שלשה - משישמע ההכרזה, וידע אם אבד לו כלום; ואם יבין שאבד, יחזור שלשה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:12:3.english: Three [days] - [He goes home for three days] once he hears the proclamation, and finds out if anything of his was lost; and if he realizes that [something] was lost, he returns [for] three [days].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:12:4.hebrew: ויכריז יום אחד - "אני אבדתי ואלו סימניה". ובגמרא פריך, דבג' ימים אין שהות לחזור לסוף א"י:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:12:4.english: And proclaim [his loss for] one day - [The owner announces:] "I lost [an item], and these are its identifying marks." And in the Gemara, [it] raises a difficulty, for in three days there is not [enough] time to return to the end of the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:13:1.english: Neighbors of the place where the lost item was found - Perhaps it is theirs.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:15:1.hebrew: כדי שיגיע כו' - ולא ידביקוהו הגשמים. אלמא כולי האי בעינן, ומתני' תני שלשה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:15:1.english: So that [he] reaches, etc. - So that the rains do not overtake him. Thus, we require all this [time], whereas our Mishnah teaches three [days].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:18:1.hebrew: והכתיב וישבו כל ישראל בעריהם - ואע"ג דפורתא הוו, בכל עריהן היו מפוזרים, ויש רחוקים מירושלים כבתחילה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:18:1.english: But isn't it written: "And all Israel dwelt in their cities" - Even though they were few, they were scattered throughout all their cities, and there were [some] far from Jerusalem as at first.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:19:1.hebrew: ה"ג - וכיון דהכי הוא, איפכא מסתברא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:19:1.english: This is the reading - And since it is so, the opposite is reasonable.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:19:2.hebrew: דמצות עלמא - צוות יש לו, טובים השנים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:19:2.english: Because the world has companionship - It has company; "two are better [than one]."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:1:1.hebrew: אלא הא דתנן מצא תכריך - דמשום סימנא מהדרינן, ואם נתן מלוה סימן מחזירין לו. ואי נפול מיניה דלוה, מי ניחא ליה דתיהוי הך תקנתא דניהדרה בסימן? והא ניחא ליה דנהוו ביד המוצא לעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:1:1.english: But [what about] that which we learned [in the Mishnah]: "If one found a roll [of documents]" - For we return [them] on account of a distinguishing mark, and if the creditor provides a distinguishing mark, we return [them] to him. And if they fell from the debtor, is it satisfactory to him that there be this enactment that we return it by a distinguishing mark? Surely it is satisfactory to him that they remain in the finder's possession forever.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:21:1.english: Learn from it - Since according to the Rabbis they only give him time [for] going and returning.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:21:2.hebrew: גלימא מכריז - זה שמצאה מכריז שם חפץ: "טלית מצאתי", ולכך לא הוצרכו ליתן שהות יום אחד לעיין בכליו מה אבד, שהאדם יודע כמה טליתות יש לו, וכשהוא בביתו בודק אם ימצאנה, ואין צריך שהות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:21:2.english: He proclaims a cloak - The one who found it proclaims the name of the item, "I found a cloak," and therefore they did not need to grant a delay of one day to examine his belongings [to see] what was lost, for a person knows how many cloaks he has, and when he is at home he checks whether he finds it, and no delay is needed.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:22:1.hebrew: דאי ס"ד אבידתא מכריז - ואינו מזכיר שם החפץ, ליתבו ליה לכל חד וחד אכתי טפי יומא לעיוני במאניה, אם כל כליו בידו. ופלוגתא היא בהא לקמן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:22:1.english: For if it enters your mind [that] he proclaims "a lost item" - and does not mention the name of the object, they would have to give each and every one yet an additional day to examine his belongings, [to see] whether all his vessels are in his possession. And there is a dispute about this later on.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:22:2.english: They did not trouble - this [finder] that he should wait more than seven days.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:23:1.english: The first festival - that he proclaims.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:23:2.hebrew: אומר - בהכריזו, זהו רגל ראשון, שלא להטריח את האובד לחזור, וכשיבא רגל שני יעלה לרגל ויתן סימניה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:23:2.english: He says - When he proclaims [it, he says], "This is the first pilgrimage Festival," so as not to trouble the one who lost [the item] to return [now]; and when the second pilgrimage Festival comes, he will go up for the Festival and give its identifying marks.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:23:3.hebrew: שלישי אומר סתם - אבידה מצאתי, ואינו אומר איזה רגל הוא למציאתה, כדי שלא יסמוך האובד על רגל הבא, ויבין שזהו רגל האחרון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:23:3.english: [On the] third [pilgrimage Festival, he] says [it] without specification - [He says,] "I found a lost item," and he does not state which Festival it is since its finding, so that the one who lost [the item] will not rely on the next Festival, and will understand that this is the final Festival.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:3:1.hebrew: אם תימצי לומר סימנים דאורייתא - רבותא נקט, דאפי' אמרינן דאורייתא, אפ"ה עדים עדיפי, כדמפרש ואזיל: "סימנין ועדים ינתן לבעל עדים":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:3:1.english: If you say [that] distinguishing marks are by Torah law - He stated a novelty: that even [if] we say [they are] by Torah law, nevertheless witnesses are superior, as he goes on to explain: "[If one brings] distinguishing marks and [another brings] witnesses, it shall be given to the one with witnesses."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:4:1.english: Distinguishing marks and distinguishing marks - Two [people] came and gave its distinguishing marks.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:4:2.english: He shall leave [it] - Until Elijah comes.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:6:1.english: The measure of its length, etc. - This one states the measure of its length, and that one gives the measure of its width.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:6:2.hebrew: שעורי משער לה - אם ראה אותה ביד הבעלים, שיערה כשהיה בעלה מכוסה בה, אם טלית היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:6:2.english: He approximates it - If he saw it in the owner's possession, he approximated it when its owner was covered in it, if it is a cloak.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:7:1.hebrew: מדת ארכו ורחבו ומדת גמיו - זה אומר כך ארכו וכך רחבה, וזה אומר ארכה ורחבה כך וכך אמות בין הכל, אבל אינו יודע כמה באורך וכמה ברוחב:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:7:1.english: The measure of its length and its width, and the measure of its gamma - One [claimant] says, "Its length is such-and-such and its width is such-and-such," and the other says, "Its length and its width are such-and-such cubits in total," but he does not know how much [is] in the length and how much [is] in the width.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:7:2.hebrew: גמיו - גאם יוונית עשויה כמין ך' שלנו, להכי קרי אורך ורוחב יחד גמיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:7:2.english: Its gammas [gamav] - The Greek [letter] gamma is shaped like our [letter] ך; therefore, [the Gemara] calls length and width together gamav.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:9:1.hebrew: הוא אומר סימני הגט - ואמר ממני נפל, שנמלכתי שלא ליתן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:9:1.english: He states the distinguishing marks of the bill of divorce - and says: It fell from me, for I reconsidered [and decided] not to give [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:9:2.hebrew: והיא אומרת סימני הגט - וממני נפל, שנתנו לי וגרשתני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:9:2.english: And she states the distinguishing marks of the bill of divorce - And [she claims]: "It fell from me, for he gave it to me and you divorced me."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:9:3.hebrew: ינתן לה - שהוא נתנו ויודע סימנין, אבל היא, אם לא נתנו לה, מהיכן ידעה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 28a:9:3.english: It shall be given to her - For he gave it and knows [its] distinguishing marks, whereas she — if he had not given it to her, from where would she know [them]?

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 28a:15:1.hebrew: חמשה עשר יום - וא"ת: והלא א"י היא ארבע מאות פרסה על ארבע מאות פרסה. ומהלך אדם עשרה פרסאות ביום — הוי ארבעים יום באורך; וירושלים מן הירדן, שהוא תחום א"י, מהלך יום אחד, כדאיתא בביצה (דף ה.) — נשאר מצד אחד ל"ט ימים! וי"ל דעם כרמים ויערים היה ארבע מאות פרסה, אבל מישוב לא היה כל כך:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 28a:15:1.english: Fifteen days - And if you ask: Is not the Land of Israel four hundred parsah by four hundred parsah? And a person's [daily] journey is ten parsah per day — [so] it is forty days in length; and Jerusalem is one day's journey from the Jordan, which is the boundary of the Land of Israel, as stated in Beitzah (5a) — [thus] thirty-nine days remain on one side! And one can say that with vineyards and forests it was four hundred parsah, but of settled area it was not that much.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 28a:17:1.hebrew: לא בעינן כולי האי - וסגי בתלתא יומי. וא"ת דז' ימים ומחצה צריך, דהיינו חצי של ט"ו יום? וי"ל דכי לא שכיחי שיירתא ואין הולך בלילה, גם כל היום אינו הולך, לפי שלא ימצא מלון בערב:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 28a:17:1.english: We do not need that much - And three days suffice. And if you ask: Seven and a half days are needed, which is half of fifteen days? One can answer that when caravans are not common and one does not travel at night, one also does not travel the entire day, because one will not find an inn in the evening.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 28a:1:1.hebrew: מצא תכריך של שטרות מי ניחא ליה ללוה כו' - וא"ת: אין, ניחא ליה, דכי ילוה לאחר דליהדרו ליה לדידיה? וי"ל: דאינו רוצה להפסיד עתה כדי להיות בספק ריוח פעם אחרת:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 28a:1:1.english: "[If one] found a roll of documents... is it satisfactory to the debtor, etc." - And if you ask: Yes, it is satisfactory to him, so that when he lends to another [and loses the document], they will return [it] to him? And one can answer: He does not want to lose now in order to have an uncertain gain another time.
